# Fixture provenance

Changes `kit-api-sync` (design D2) and `kit-api-sync-0-27` (design D10, re-recorded 2026-11-24). Each response fixture is `{ "status", "headers", "body" }` with lowercase header names (only the headers the client reads); a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header is kept raw (base64) and decoded under `paymentRequired`. No credit token, seed or key is stored: `<credit-token>` and `<payment-response>` are placeholders that test support code replaces at run time.

Recorded fixtures: unpaid, read-only requests to `https://api.criptonlabs.com` on 2026-11-24 (about 09:49 UTC), `network: mainnet production`, API 0.27.0 (main `8bbad8ca`; `GET /openapi.json` sha256 `dd006ecba554ed303d3dae96343a44209d65d7a5744c05bc32cd32c420f0c177`, equal to the committed snapshot), without any payment header, credential or SIWX proof. Bodies are the parsed production JSON, pretty-printed; the kept header values are verbatim (the challenges' SIWX nonces and timestamps are those of the recording).

Spec-derived fixtures: built from the API main spec `prepaid-credits` at `8bbad8ca` (`openspec/specs/prepaid-credits/spec.md`) because they need a real payment or a signed proof; values reuse the recorded fixtures (origin, bundle ids, amounts, networks, challenge).

## Changes of the 2026-11-24 re-recording (API 0.27.0, main `8bbad8ca`, change `kit-api-sync-0-27` task 1.1)

- Re-recorded (unpaid, read-only, `network: mainnet production`, no body and no proof on the POSTs, request URLs as in the table above): `price-index.json`, `requirements-payment-readiness.json`, `challenge-payment-readiness.json`, `topup-challenge-usd-starter.json`, `rotation-challenge.json`. Kept headers are those the previous files carried (`content-type`, `cache-control`, `payment-required`), verbatim.
- `requirements-fee-off.json` (a bare body, no envelope, as before) cannot be recorded: production charges (`payments_mode` `x402`). It is spec-derived from the 2026-11-24 recorded fee requirements body with `accepts` `[]` and `payments_mode` `"off"` (API main spec `x402-payments` "Price index when payments are off" for `payments_mode`; its `accepts` is empty when nothing is charged, as in the 0.21.0 derivation).
- Spec-derived, rebuilt from the re-recorded files with the rules in the table: `credit-refusal-insufficient.json` (headers and body of `challenge-payment-readiness.json` plus `error` `credits_insufficient`; `prepaid-credits` "Credit refusal"); `topup-ambiguous-402.json` (headers, `x402Version`, `resource`, `accepts`, `title`, `status` and `instance` of `topup-challenge-usd-starter.json`; `type`, `detail`, `pending_token` and `event_id` unchanged from the 0.21.0 derivation; `prepaid-credits` "Provisional token on ambiguous top-up settlement"); `credit-paid-fee.json` (body is `packages/xrpl/tests/fixtures/responses/fee.json`, headers unchanged); `siwx-next-challenge.json` (body is `packages/solana/tests/fixtures/responses/slot-latest.json`, headers unchanged).
- Checked and kept unchanged: `topup-201-usd-starter.json` and `rotation-201.json` (their members match `prepaid-credits` "Top-up purchase" and "Token rotation" at `8bbad8ca`).
- Credits-only fixtures `requirements-fee-credits.json` and `challenge-fee-credits-only.json` are spec-derived, not recorded: production at 0.27.0 serves every `/v1/pro/*` route in mode `both` (the recorded `price-index.json` has no `credits` entry) since the price tables of the API change `per-call-tiers-and-catalog`, so no credits-only route exists to record. The API still defines `mode: "credits"` (`RouteEntry` in `src/config/prices.ts`) and the `credits_only` refusal. They are built from the 2026-11-24 recordings of `GET /v1/pro/requirements?resource=/v1/pro/xrpl/fee` and unpaid `GET /v1/pro/xrpl/fee` with the route in credits mode: `accepts` `[]` (in the body and in the decoded `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`, re-encoded), no `bazaar` extension, the recorded `com.criptonlabs/prepaid-credits` and `sign-in-with-x` extensions kept with their 0.27.0 member names (`payments_mode` `x402` on the requirements body). Sources: API main spec `x402-payments` "Price index by mode" and "Requirements for a credits-only resource" (price table `2026-10-18`) and `prepaid-credits` credits-only refusal.
- Bundles no longer carry `activation` (`prepaid-credits` bundles at `8bbad8ca`); the price index carries `denominations` and no `debit{}` / `approx_calls{}` maps.
